qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary outsourced call center/BPO services easily insourced, automated, or forgone; lacks essential pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Need). Teleperformance operates outsourced call centers and customer contact BPO. Customer care outsourcing is non-essential, easily forgone, or automated by enterprise clients. The labour-intensive customer care model lacks customer pricing power and faces terminal displacement by conversational AI agents.
qualitative.evidence: Teleperformance operates a global labor-intensive contact center footprint with over 400,000 employees. Contracts are commoditized and subject to client budget cuts, insourcing, and aggressive deflationary pressure from generative AI customer support agents.
